confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on search-result excerpts from aggregated Tampa sources (Numbeo, CityCost, Expatistan and a travel-budget site), not full page reads. Numbeo is crowd-sourced and some pages may be dated. Beer and cappuccino are best supported. The inexpensive meal rests on about two sources. The mid-range anchor sits slightly above the dinner-for-two aggregates (about 75) to allow for menu drift, and drink exclusion is unconfirmed. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the draft beer anchor because venue-level samples were sparse. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July and were not checked against live booking pages, listings or searches. FX is from RBA search-result snippets, not a direct page read, and a 19 November observation may also exist. Verify before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink anchors are Tampa-specific, with no comparable-city proxy. Accommodation tiers are holistic estimates for a mid-sized US metro in July, a typically softer leisure period in Tampa, and are not benchmarked to a named comparable city.
